name: Punta Gorda Boat Parade
address: Punta Gorda Isles, Punta Gorda, FL
when_note: Sails at 6 PM, rain or shine with no rain date
paras: The Saturday Night Before Christmas Eve Boat Parade, sponsored by the Punta Gorda Isles Civic Association, sails on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 6 PM. The parade site calls it the 26th annual fleet and says it runs rain or shine with no rain date.

The lighted parade covers about four and a half miles inside the protected canals of Punta Gorda Isles with no bridges. The organizers say there are no designated public viewing areas, but thousands of spectators find spots along the route, including near the Santa's Cove parade start. Drivers are asked not to park on the street, and many people bring chairs early. Boaters who want to watch from the water must anchor securely away from the parade path, and the child life jacket rule is enforced.
tip: Bring a chair, arrive early and do not park on the street.

name: Light Up the Night Christmas Tree Lighting in Downtown Punta Gorda
address: West Marion Avenue and Taylor Street, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
when_note: Starts at 4 PM, Santa arrives at 6 PM, tree lighting at 8:30 PM
host: PG Light Up the Tree, Inc.
paras: PG Light Up the Tree, Inc. holds its community Christmas tree lighting in Downtown Punta Gorda on Friday, December 4, 2026. The organizers say the event is open to all at no cost to attendees.

The festival starts at 4 PM with vendors, hot cocoa, food trucks, bounce houses, play snow and costumed characters, and Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive at 6 PM to hear wish lists. Live music runs on two stages, and the tree lighting countdown is at 8:30 PM with gentle snowflakes falling. A 50/50 raffle drawing follows at 9 PM.
tip: Come at 4 PM for the kids' activities and stay for the 8:30 PM countdown.

name: Santa and Grinch Visits at Fishermen's Village
address: 1200 W. Retta Esplanade, Punta Gorda, FL 33950
when_note: Grinch Fridays 5 to 8 PM and Saturdays 4 to 7 PM, Santa Sunday November 29 noon to 4 PM
paras: Fishermen's Village in Punta Gorda lists photo visits with the Grinch just inside the main entrance. The remaining 2026 Grinch dates are Friday, November 27, Friday, December 4, Saturday, December 5, Friday, December 11, Friday, December 18 and Saturday, December 19. Friday visits run from 5 PM to 8 PM and Saturday visits from 4 PM to 7 PM.

The village also lists Visits with Santa on Sunday, November 29, 2026, from noon to 4 PM inside the main entrance at 1200 W. Retta Esplanade. The village describes its events as free with free parking, so families only need to bring a camera.
tip: Pick a Friday for the longer 5 to 8 PM Grinch window.
